decisive_spans.text: numerous round, thin-walled air cysts (2–5 mm) scattered in both lungs

response.rationale: Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome is strongly supported by recurrent spontaneous pneumothoraces and the presence of numerous round, thin-walled lung cysts. Ehlers-Danlos syndrome is less likely as it is contradicted by the absence of focal parenchymal abnormalities, and while it supports recurrent pneumothoraces, the specific cyst morphology points more towards Birt-Hogg-Dube.
